python - << 'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('lib/widgets/void_settings_sheet.dart')
s=p.read_text()
anchor = "        _Cycle('void-settings-screen', 'screen', labelFor(cfg.type), cycleScreen),"
pos = s.find(anchor)
assert pos!=-1, 'anchor not found'
insert = (
"        if (cfg.type == ScreenType.cassette) ...[\n"
"          _Cycle(\n"
"            'void-settings-cassette-variant',\n"
"            'variant',\n"
"            cassetteVariantMeta[cfg.variant]!.label,\n"
"            () {\n"
"              final next = CassetteVariant.values[\n"
"                  (cfg.variant.index + 1) % CassetteVariant.values.length];\n"
"              settings.saveScreenConfig(cfg.copyWith(variant: next));\n"
"            },\n"
"          ),\n"
"        ],"
)
new_s = s[:pos+len(anchor)] + "\n" + insert + s[pos+len(anchor):]
p.write_text(new_s)
print('Patched')
PY
